why: Corrections to the catalog snapshot (model_prices.json, from LiteLLM with models.dev as fallback), checked against the vendor's own pricing page. An override beats the catalog and loses to a human's `cci price set`. Each entry says what the catalog gets wrong, where the right number came from, and when someone last looked; delete an entry once upstream agrees -- `cci price sync` says when it does -- and move it to `retired` with the reason. Rates are the vendor's five columns collapsed to ours: base input, 5m cache write, 1h cache write, cache hit, output, per million tokens. An entry is matched by its `id` exactly -- the same spelling rules as the catalog (provider prefix, date suffix, `.` for `-`) but never fuzzily -- so it cannot reach a model it does not name: `claude-fable-5-1` and `claude-fable-5` differ only in cache reads, and a correction that caught both would reintroduce the error it exists to fix.

retired.corrected: genai-prices had no entry of its own for Fable 5.1 and matched it to `claude-fable-5`, whose cache reads cost four times as much ($1 against $0.25 per MTok). On a corpus where cache reads were 59% of the bill that substitution was worth $2,752, or 21% of the total.
retired.why_retired: LiteLLM has an exact `claude-fable-5-1` key at $10/$50, cache read $0.25, 5m write $12.50, 1h write $20 -- the override's numbers exactly, and the claude-api skill's model table agrees ($10/$50, cache read $0.25). The version boundary in the matcher also stops it falling back to `claude-fable-5` if the key ever goes.

retired.corrected: Limited availability, so genai-prices did not carry it at all and its traffic was reported unpriced. The vendor lists it at Fable 5.1's rates, cheap cache hits included.
retired.why_retired: LiteLLM has an exact `claude-mythos-5-1` key at $10/$50, cache read $0.25, 5m write $12.50, 1h write $20 -- the override's numbers exactly.

retired.corrected: As claude-mythos-5-1, at Claude Fable 5's rates -- standard 0.1x cache hits, not Fable 5.1's 0.025x.
retired.why_retired: LiteLLM has an exact `claude-mythos-5` key at $10/$50, cache read $1, 5m write $12.50, 1h write $20 -- the override's numbers exactly.

retired.corrected: genai-prices carried a price rise on 2026-09-01 to $3/$15 that did not happen: those are Claude Sonnet 4.6's rates. The vendor still listed Sonnet 5 at $2/$10 with $0.20 cache hits.
retired.why_retired: LiteLLM has an exact `claude-sonnet-5` key at $2/$10, cache read $0.20, 5m write $2.50, 1h write $4 and no dated rise -- the override's numbers exactly. Not on the claude-api skill's table, which lists Sonnet 5.5 at the same $2/$10; the vendor page was last read for Sonnet 5 on 2026-09-20.
